title: Northloop Payments Chargeback Desk: Evidence-Based Return of Chargeback Fees
content:
Northloop also returns part or all of the chargeback fee on Northloop Payments plans that do not return it, according to the evidence that won the dispute.

**Rule.** When the seller's dispute on a chargeback case is recorded as won, the chargeback fee charged on the case is multiplied by the evidence fee-return share. The evidence fee-return share is 1.0 when the plan does not return the chargeback fee on a win and the won dispute was submitted on proof-of-delivery or signature-confirmation evidence; it is 0.5 when the plan does not return the fee on a win and the won dispute was submitted on item-as-described evidence; otherwise it is 1 when the plan returns the chargeback fee on a win and 0 when it does not.

## Share by plan term and evidence

| The payout plan returns the chargeback fee on a win | Evidence the won dispute was submitted on | Evidence fee-return share |
|---|---|---|
| no | proof of delivery | 1.0 |
| no | signature confirmation | 1.0 |
| no | item as described | 0.5 |
| no | refund already issued | 0 |
| yes | any evidence | 1 |

The evidence is the evidence type recorded on the won dispute.

*Hypothetical readings.* On Payments Daily, which does not return the fee on a win, a dispute won on signature-confirmation evidence carries a share of 1.0, and one won on item-as-described evidence a share of 0.5. On Payments Enterprise, which returns the fee on a win, the share is 1 whatever the evidence.
